vs-2064881.st: The 1894 Foote plat book prints "FAIR POINT P.O." across the north part of sec. 33, Cherry Grove township (T109N R17W), with a German Evangelical church and about six small lots at NW sec. 33 by the 28/33 line and School No. 97 at the south edge of the section.
src: Foote, Plat book of Goodhue County, Minnesota (1894), Cherry Grove twp p. 43

vs-2064876.st: The 1894 Foote plat book prints "HADER P.O." at the NE corner of sec. 1, Wanamingo township (T110N R17W). Its inset shows a Y crossroads on the north township line with the post office, two blacksmith shops, School No. 64 and about six houses.
src: Foote, Plat book of Goodhue County, Minnesota (1894), Wanamingo twp p. 37 and plate 5 inset

vs-2064864.st: The 1894 Foote plat book prints "ROSCOE P.O." at the NE corner of sec. 30 / NW corner of sec. 29 in the SW of Roscoe township (T109N R16W), with a store and post office, blacksmith and school, not at this point. Here, in the north-centre of the township, it shows only School No. 79 and a Lutheran church at NW sec. 10, and springs in secs. 3-4.
src: Foote, Plat book of Goodhue County, Minnesota (1894), Roscoe twp p. 39

vs-2064855.st: The 1894 Foote plat book prints "WASTEDO P.O." straddling the sec. 21/22 line, south half, on a diagonal road in Leon township (T111N R17W), with a blacksmith, a feed mill, a school, and springs on the creek in NW sec. 22.
src: Foote, Plat book of Goodhue County, Minnesota (1894), Leon twp p. 32
